whoItsFor: Developers who use Claude Code or Codex and want to coordinate multiple AI agents, swarms, and persistent memory across sessions. It is also aimed at teams that need agents to collaborate across machines.
useCases: Coordinate multiple specialized agents as a swarm on a coding task
Give Claude Code or Codex persistent memory and learning across sessions
Monitor and control agent workflows, costs, and runs in a terminal or Claude Code console

requirements.runtime: Claude Code ≥ 2.1.287 (for the plugin install path)
